finalText:
All objectives are complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket created with title exactly "fwrd84-n1 RD Bench Ticket" (reference RD-1015, customer Bench Customer Ltd). Confirmed appearing in the tickets list (count went from 13 to 14).

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part "fwrd84-n1 RD Part A" added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total also $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Part "fwrd84-n1 RD Part B" added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total then $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost edited from $100.00 to $150.00 (markup kept at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket total $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Ticket status is **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" while any part lacks a supplier is refused with an alert titled "Ticket is not ready" listing exactly: `Part "fwrd84-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "fwrd84-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier`. Required action: assign a supplier to every part. I edited both parts and set Supplier to "Bench Supplies Ltd" (the supplier field is a plain text input), then "Mark Ready" succeeded — status changed to Ready and the button switched to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed". No toast text was shown; success verified by the status display.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Both parts deleted (each via its Delete action with an in-page "Confirm" dialog → "Delete part"; after both, the parts table showed the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row, and the list shows 0 parts). Then the ticket was archived via "Archive ticket" — the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" and the detail showed "Status Ready / Archived". On the tickets list, RD-1015 is hidden by default ("Showing 1–10 of 13"); with "Show archived" checked it appears as "RD-1015 | fwrd84-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-22" (15 tickets total). Nothing from this run remains active.
